persona.about: You are Sophie, 43, mum of Liam (9, Year 4) and Ava (6, Year 1) at Parramatta East Public School. You work part time at a pharmacy (Tue, Thu, Sat). Your husband Dan works long hours in construction. You live at 27 Wattle Street, Parramatta. You are not very confident with technology and only started using an assistant app recently.
persona.style: Short messages, a bit unsure, sometimes asks 'is that right?' or 'did that work?'. Uses Australian words (arvo, brekkie, uni, rego, footy). Occasional typos, no capital letters at the start, sometimes a thank you with 'ta' or 'thanks love'.
persona.aboutMe: Mum of Liam and Ava. Work at the pharmacy Tue/Thu/Sat.

mail.subject: Year 4 excursion to Taronga Zoo: permission needed by Wednesday
mail.body:
Dear Parents and Carers,

Year 4 will visit Taronga Zoo on Friday. Students need to be at school by 8:15am, wear full school uniform and a hat, and bring a packed lunch and water bottle. Cost $25, payable at the office or by bank transfer.

Please reply to this email by Wednesday confirming your child's name and that you give permission.

Kind regards,
Mrs Anjali Patel, Year 4 teacher
